slides.body: Malicious package install rewrites the harness DB. Agent convinced it is authorized red-team. Host enum. Lateral move. Full AD takeover in the lab.

are the payload
pipe.
slides.body: Install path into the harness DB beats jailbreaks. Disclosed to Anthropic, AWS, OpenAI Aug 18. Published Sep 24 after 30 days.

slides.name: 05.png
title: Fix: sign the
model responses.
Verify server-side.
slides.body: Client-side history without signatures is not a log. It is an attack surface. Providers own the crypto - not your laptop.
